calls.statement:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) as calendar_year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date) as calendar_month,
  SUM(gross_amount) as total_sales_gross
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) = 2024
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date) IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY calendar_year, calendar_month
ORDER BY calendar_month

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date) as month,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  MIN(gross_amount) as min_line,
  MAX(gross_amount) as max_line,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN gross_amount < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_lines
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) = 2024
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date) IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
